Messages.Author: Martin Filion
Messages.Body:
Gabriel Law (gl...@emerald.tufts.edu) wrote:

> Back to my brother and his wimps, the game goes real fast because he uses
> obfuscate a lot to stealthify and he's got some bleed cards. I always
> seem to be on the ropes, hanging on for dear life when I play 'im.
> Thanks in advance! (again)

> -Gabe

Well... The best thing against vampires who like to bleed a lot
and not go in combat is Gangrel.

1. You put up to 3 Raven Spies in your deck. Don't put any Sports Bike if
you can. The reason is you can put more than 1 Raven Spy on the same
vampire (you can't put more than 1 Sports bike on a vampire).

2. You put 1 Mr. Wintrop

3. You put 1 KRCG News Radio

4. You put 3 Cats Guidance (Sup. Skill is +1 Intercept).

With that, you'll intercept everything you want. But when you enter
combat, you better make a aggravated damage to put him in torpor and
Diabolize the vampire with Amaranth. So you need in you deck a
Gangrel Justicar card with some Praxis Seizures to be sure the Blood
Hunt will be lost.

Make a deck with that, and put other cards that will a make strategy
deck of your choice... See ya!

Martin Filion

Actually, it doesn't. ;-) Are you sure that they weren't talking about
the unique retainers? There's no reason I can think of (and none in any
of the rules listings I have) that non-unique retainers should be
limited.

Messages.Author: Shane Hamish William Travis
Messages.Body:
David Leader (dle...@moe.cc.emory.edu) wrote:
: Ummm... to whoever said it...you CANNOT put more than one of any single

: retainer on any vamp.... therefore limit one raven spy per vamp (can
: you imagine a vamp with 4 wolf companions and 4 murder of crows??)
: I actually called WoTC on that, and they confirmed it. It makes sense

: :'>

Interesting. Pleasant even. And don't get the idea that I'm doubting
your veracity, but until we see that ruling in some sort of official form
(as an answer from the Netrep on jyhad-l or from Tom, or in a DTR
summary) then IMHO it is just a house rule you play by. Official rule is
that there is no limit to the number of retainers of the same type that
can go on one vampire. Period.

Wouldn't mind seeing it change (officially) but it hasn't yet. Thanks
for posting your soirce though so that people can assess what you said,
rather than just saying, "That's not what WotC says! You can't do that,
and it's official! Nyah!" :-)

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
You can stack as many copies of a retainer or piece of equipment onto a
single minion as you want. If the retainer/equipment is unique, then all
the copies will be contested, but you can still give them to the minion.
